visual.description: Full-viewport hero with text and CTA anchored bottom-left (~40% width) and a large Mars planet image filling the right 60%, both on a pure black background.
Full-bleed section with a rocket launch photograph occupying the left ~55% and text block with heading, body, and CTA on the right ~45%, text overlapping the image slightly.
Full-bleed aerial photograph on the left ~55%, with heading and body text on the lower-right ~45%, transitioning into a next section below.
Two full-width image panels stacked vertically — top half shows a close-up astronaut in helmet, bottom half shows a satellite hardware corridor with text label beginning to appear at the bottom edge.
Full-bleed dark section with text block and CTA on the left ~40% and a satellite array photograph filling the right ~55%, with footer navigation bar at the bottom.
Same Starlink section at a slightly different scroll position, confirming the fixed left-text / right-image split layout with footer still visible.
